task.title: Circuit and landing
task.goal: Take off, fly the four circuit waypoints in order, make a stable approach to the landing spot on the runway centreline, 150 m past its threshold, and land on it. The aircraft is a quadcopter drone: it takes off and lands vertically, hovers in place and flies forward at up to 45 kt.

result.reason: time budget of 750 s of simulated time reached
